name: Settlement
description: A village by the road, drawn from shapes: cottages with lit windows and smoking chimneys, a well, a market stall, picket fences, hay bales, a cart and a woodpile. Use as "@settlement#<name>".

cottage.description: A timber-framed cottage with lit windows and a smoking chimney; lights the ground before it warmly.

well.description: A stone well with a little roof, a windlass and a bucket.

market_stall.description: A market stall: a counter heaped with fruit and bread under a striped awning.

picket_fence.description: A white picket fence, two metres to a section: space its layer every 1.9 m for an unbroken fence.

haybale.description: A bale of hay, tied with twine.

cart.description: A wooden hand cart loaded with hay.

woodpile.description: Split logs stacked for the winter, their cut ends showing.
